title: Plumeform floating nav pill
description: A rounded glass pill floating 8px from the top and sticky for the whole page: wordmark, centred links with small chevrons, a quiet sign-in link and a pill button. It turns dark glass while over dark bands and pale glass over paper; on phones it folds to wordmark, button and a menu.
notes: overlaps the next block by its own height (negative margin), so a hero runs under it
tone="auto" watches for elements with data-tone="dark" (plumeform-band sets it); pass initialTone="dark" when the page opens on a dark band
name: plumeform-header

props.name: brand
props.description: wordmark next to the logo; also the home link's label

props.name: logo
props.description: logo mark (an svg, img or lucide icon) before the wordmark

props.name: links
props.description: the centred links (desktop) and the menu's links (phones)

props.name: secondary
props.description: quiet text link before the button, e.g. log in

props.name: cta
props.description: the pill button at the right end

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: label of the phone menu button, for screen readers

props.name: tone
props.description:
auto: turns dark while it sits over a band marked data-tone="dark" (plumeform-band does
this) and light elsewhere · light / dark: fixed

props.name: initialTone
props.description: the tone in the static HTML, before the page's script runs (dark when the page opens on a dark hero)
